notes: Template for a main-split ABox revision of a stored fact (15 queries). The edit moves Italy's capital to Milan, inside Italy, so subproperty and chain questions would not change; the record uses functional (related near), composition (related far and two derived), binding (San Marino) and the classic background-beliefs split (where Parliament meets). Related far is stored because the composed form is stated verbatim ("the capital of Italy and of the Lazio region", over 1,400 exact hits); the derived questions' direct forms are absent. Every bridge and side fact has a check and evidence. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate (AND queries, max_clause_freq 500000). The third derived question uses La Scala, whose name does not contain the city, so the bridge is a real hop; "opera house" is in the prompt to keep it apart from Rome's Scala Santa.
